name: The Giant

location.address: Redwood Grove Loop Trail, stop 7, Henry Cowell Redwoods State Park, Felton, Santa Cruz County
location.neighbourhood: Henry Cowell Redwoods State Park, Felton

official_register.name: California State Parks, Henry Cowell Redwoods Redwood Grove Loop Trail guide

access: Stop 7 on the signed Redwood Grove self-guided loop, a short flat walk from the park's Redwood Grove day-use area (Felton, about 10 km north of Santa Cruz). State park day-use fee applies; check parks.ca.gov for hours.
how_to_recognise: Stop 7 on the Redwood Grove loop, the biggest trunk in the grove, a few steps from the hollow Frémont Tree (stop 8).
verify_notes: State Parks trail guide (owner of the ground): 'The Giant' grows to 270 ft (83 m) tall and over 17 ft (5 m) wide. girth_cm 1628 is that width read as a diameter times pi (518 cm x pi), not a measured girth. Age: the guide gives a mature redwood age of over 2,000 years in general; an iNaturalist caption (2026-08-13, observer's own text, https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/391565595) says roughly 1,500 years and about 277 ft; a search summary quoted State Parks as 1,200 to 1,600 years and 282 ft for the park's tallest redwood, not fetched, so the age range is a broad hedge, unverified. Life: dated iNaturalist observation 2026-08-13 geotagged at the tree. Pin is the observer's phone fix, a few metres from the Frémont Tree (stops 7 and 8 are consecutive); both approximate. Park became state park 1953 after Cowell family donated land; grove earlier Santa Cruz County Big Trees Park (guide stop 14). One official source plus one dated observation: flagged. photo candidate: the iNaturalist observation (cc-by) is the tree's own signed photo, not checked for licence terms beyond the API field.

name: The Fremont Tree

location.address: Redwood Grove Loop Trail, stop 8, Henry Cowell Redwoods State Park, Felton, Santa Cruz County
location.neighbourhood: Henry Cowell Redwoods State Park, Felton

official_register.name: California State Parks, Henry Cowell Redwoods Redwood Grove Loop Trail guide

access: Stop 8 on the signed Redwood Grove self-guided loop; visitors can step inside the hollow base. State park day-use fee applies; check parks.ca.gov for hours.
how_to_recognise: A burnt-out, hollow redwood on the loop trail whose base you can walk into, stop 8, just past The Giant.
verify_notes: State Parks trail guide stop 8: General John C. Fremont reportedly spent the night in 1846 in this burnt-out hollow redwood; asked in 1888 if he ever slept in it, he answered 'It makes a great story, let it stand.' Guide calls it a still-living tree and says you can explore the inside. Story is reported, not proven. No girth, height or age published. Life: iNaturalist observations 2022-12-04, 2025-10-14 and 2026-08-13 at the tree (https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/391565560, .../321675826, .../143780397). The three phone fixes scatter about 100 m so the pin is approximate, set at their mean. One official source plus dated observations: flagged.
